about: Blind paired review behind Directed flow leaning to left to right, 2026-11-16. The fourteen gallery documents whose direction the lean changed, each drawn both ways by the same studio, shown as shuffled A/B pairs to three reviewers who were told nothing of what differed. scores are the three reviewers, 1 to 10 overall; shipped is which picture each would ship. Picks: 24 for left to right first, 12 for as before, 6 ties. flow-loops lost because the left-to-right picture began the loop at Test; that was then fixed (a turned main line costs twice as much between whole pictures) and is not reflected in these scores.
